push.title: W 3-0 vs Dingos Utd | You: 8.8
push.body:
Look at you, BellyTb1. An 8.8 against Dingos Utd. That's the good stuff.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at Dingos Utd's goal. The more you shoot, the luckier you get.
+ 2 key passes. That's playmaking, plain and simple.
+ Man of the Match, your 16th for us. Leaders make the hard moments look easy.
+ You set it up, buddskees knocked it down. Repeat as needed.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. That right there is what good teammates do.

THE BAD
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 24 (best was PhogsToffees's 34). That's the bit that kept us from winning.
- 2 tackles won: -0.1. Easy points to win back.
- Goals per shot on target: 50%. One gear up gets you to 60%+.

Practice pointer: Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.

BellyTb1, from me to you: A team that laughs together stays together. Tell a bad joke tomorrow.

You make coaching fun. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-0 vs Dingos Utd | You: 7.9
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.9 for a forward. Better than most. Not your ceiling, though, not by a long shot.

THE GOOD
+ 2 key passes. Selfless as a church potluck, and twice as filling.
+ That's a partnership I'd build a team around: you and BellyTb1.
+ Won your matchup: 7.9 against their best forward's 6.1. Keep that in your back pocket.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (28 vs their best 11). Your teammates felt that, even if the scoreboard didn't.
+ A promotion match, and we won it. That one belongs to all of us, and you were in it.

THE BAD
- 0 of 2 shots on target. Habit to build: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger. You're closer than you think.
- Missed tackles 4, up from your usual 2. It happens. It can't keep happening.
- Most giveaways on the team: 10 (best was BellyTb1's 7). That's not you at your best, and we both know it.
- Match rating 7.9, from 9.6 in your previous match. I'm not mad, I'm just writing it down.

Daily reps: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.

PhogsToffees, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: Talent wins games; teammates win seasons.

Mistakes are just lessons in disguise. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-0 vs Dingos Utd | You: 7.7
push.body:
A 7.7 against Dingos Utd, buddskees. Little below the line for a forward, but there's good stuff in here to work with.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at Dingos Utd's goal. Their defense never got a moment of peace.
+ Tackle success 67%, up from your usual 30%. Bottle that and bring it next match.
+ Won your matchup: 7.7 against their best forward's 6.1. Nobody hands out trophies for that, so here's my handshake.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (19 vs their best 11). You can build a whole match on that.
+ A promotion match, and we won it. Moments like that are why we keep showing up.

THE BAD
- Lowest match rating on the team: 7.7 (best was BellyTb1's 8.8). Fixable, but only if we fix it.
- Lowest key passes on the team: 0 (best was BellyTb1's 2). That has to tighten up.
- Lowest completed passes on the team: 19 (best was PhogsToffees's 28). One honest look at that and we move forward.
- Lowest tackles attempted on the team: 3 (best was BellyTb1's 5). Keep this in your pocket: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
- Lowest goal involvements on the team: 1 (best was BellyTb1's 2). That's on the to-do list now.

Coach's drill: Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward.

Last thing, buddskees. The scoreboard counts goals; I count growth.

We'll sharpen it at practice. - Coach Lasso
